use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line

write("start: ")

if let entered = read_line() then
    let value mut = double.parse(entered)

    let iterations mut = 0

    do
        let next = (value + 3.0) * 0.86

        iterations = iterations + 1

        if next == value then
            break
        fi

        value = next
    od

    write_line("quiescent at {value:0.0000000000} after {iterations} steps")
fi

use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line

write("start: ")

if let entered = read_line() then
    let value mut = double.parse(entered)

    let iterations mut = 0

    do
        let next = (value + 3.0) * 0.86

        iterations = iterations + 1

        if next == value then
            break
        fi

        value = next
    od

    write_line("quiescent at {value:0.0000000000} after {iterations} steps")
fi
